title: Antenatal Care (ANC) Four-Visit Schedule
summary: Mandatory milestones, tests, and nutrition interventions for every pregnant woman in India.
source_org: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (MoHFW), Govt of India
official_citation: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) / National Health Mission
key_points: Visit 1: Within 12 weeks of conception for early registration, baseline vitals, Hb test, and Td-1 injection.
Visit 2: Between 14 and 26 weeks for ultrasound screening, abdominal palpation, and fetal heartbeat check.
Visit 3: At 28 to 34 weeks for gestational diabetes check, severe anemia detection, and preeclampsia screening.
Visit 4: At 36 weeks until term for presentation, institutional delivery birth plan, and danger signs counseling.
telugu_summary: గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలకు కనీసం 4 సార్లు ఆశా మరియు ప్రాథమిక ఆరోగ్య కేంద్రం ద్వారా తప్పనిసరిగా ఏఎన్‌సీ పరీక్షలు జరపాలి.
hindi_summary: प्रत्येक गर्भवती महिला को कम से कम 4 अनिवार्य प्रसव पूर्व जांच (ANC) करानी चाहिए।

title: National Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP) Schedule
summary: Complete childhood vaccine timeline from birth through 5 years protecting against 12 life-threatening diseases.
key_points: At Birth: BCG (0.1 ml intradermal), Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV 0 dose, 2 drops), Hepatitis B birth dose (within 24 hrs).
6 Weeks: Pentavalent-1 (0.5 ml IM), OPV-1, Rotavirus-1 (5 drops), Fractional IPV-1 (0.1 ml), PCV-1.
10 Weeks: Pentavalent-2 (0.5 ml IM), OPV-2, Rotavirus-2.
14 Weeks: Pentavalent-3, OPV-3, Rotavirus-3, Fractional IPV-2, PCV-2.
9-12 Months: Measles-Rubella-1 (MR-1, 0.5 ml SC), PCV Booster, Vitamin A dose 1 (1 ml / 1 lakh IU).
telugu_summary: శిశువు పుట్టినప్పటి నుండి నిర్దిష్ట సమయాల్లో టీకాలు వేయించడం వలన 12 రకాల ప్రమాదకర వ్యాధుల నుండి రక్షణ లభిస్తుంది.
hindi_summary: राष्ट्रीय टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम के तहत जन्म से लेकर 5 वर्ष तक सभी आवश्यक टीके समय पर लगवाएं।

title: Child Malnutrition & Growth Monitoring (MUAC & Edema)
summary: Protocol for screening Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) and Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM) in rural villages.
official_citation: Management of Severe Acute Malnutrition at Community Level (MoHFW)
key_points: Measure Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) for all children aged 6 to 59 months using standard Shakir tape.
MUAC < 115 mm (Red Zone): Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) — Immediate referral to Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre (NRC).
MUAC 115 mm - 125 mm (Yellow Zone): Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM) — Targeted supplementary nutrition and follow-up.
Check for Bilateral Pitting Edema: Press thumbs gently over both feet for 3 seconds. Persistent indentation indicates nutritional edema.
telugu_summary: 6 నుండి 59 నెలల పిల్లలలో చేతి చుట్టుకొలత (MUAC) టేప్ ద్వారా పౌష్టికాహార లోపం తీవ్రతను వెంటనే గుర్తించవచ్చు.
hindi_summary: 6 से 59 महीने के बच्चों में शाकिर टेप द्वारा कुपोषण की जांच करें। 115 मिमी से कम होने पर तुरंत NRC रेफर करें।

title: Hypertension & Diabetes Screening Protocol (NP-NCD)
summary: Doorstep screening methodology for blood pressure and diabetes for all adults aged 30 and older.
source_org: National Programme for Prevention & Control of NCDs (NP-NCD) / MoHFW
official_citation: Ayushman Bharat Health & Wellness Centre NCD Screening Protocol
key_points: Every adult aged 30+ years should have their Blood Pressure and Random Blood Glucose screened at least once a year.
Normal BP: Systolic < 120 and Diastolic < 80 mmHg.
Stage 1 Hypertension: 130-139 / 80-89 mmHg — Advise dietary sodium reduction, physical activity, re-check in 2 weeks.
Hypertensive Crisis: BP >= 160/110 mmHg with headache or blurred vision requires same-day medical referral to PHC.
telugu_summary: 30 సంవత్సరాలు దాటిన ప్రతి ఒక్కరికీ రక్తపోటు మరియు చక్కెర స్థాయిలను పరీక్షించి జీవనశైలి మార్పులు సూచించాలి.
hindi_summary: 30 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के सभी नागरिकों का बीपी और शुगर जांच नियमित रूप से करवाएं।
